segments.text: What is the core purpose and spiritual philosophy behind the Mahotsav?A Celebration of Total Surrender (Samarpan): Ashaeiynn operates strictly as a non-profit organization. The Mahotsav is celebrated annually as a way to give back every single profit earned throughout the year. All financial reserves are utilized entirely to purchase samagri (sacred offerings) for the 24-hour continuous havan that burns for all 25 days of the Mahotsav. Every single bit is offered into the holy fire until Ashaeiynn's bank account reaches zero.​Cultivating Absolute Faith: Returning to zero at the conclusion of the Mahotsav keeps the foundation grounded, instills deep humility, and fosters complete dependency on Gurudev. It serves as a living testimony that even when material reserves are completely emptied, Gurudev's grace continues to overflow and sustain us.​Honoring Baba Ramdev Pir Ji: The Mahotsav begins on Bhadve ki Dooj (the second day of the bright fortnight of the Hindu month of Bhadrapada, which is falling on 12th September this year), marking the birth anniversary of Baba Ramdev Pir Ji. As the Kuldevta (lineage deity) of Parikshit Bhaiya and his family, Baba Ramdev Pir Ji holds a supreme position alongside Gurudev in Ashaeiynn. The entire festival is a celebration of the immense grace and blessings he has showered upon Ashaeiynn.​Rare Access, Learning & Community​Direct Learning at Gurudev's Feet: While access to Ashaeiynn normally requires special permission, the Mahotsav is completely open to all. Sitting directly at the feet of Gurudev, Parikshit Bhaiya, and other mentors provides an extraordinary, rare opportunity to absorb deep spiritual insights and enhance your third eye in Gurudev's presence.​A Sacred Family Gathering: Beyond personal sadhana, the Mahotsav serves as a grand spiritual family reunion. It offers a welcoming space to meet fellow disciples and devotees, build lasting friendships, share experiences, and learn collectively as a community.Receiving Divine Grace & Blessings​Gathering of Saints: A major purpose of the Mahotsav is for devotees to receive the grace and divine presence of the millions of saints personally invited by Gurudev and Ashaeiynn's Parikshit Bhaiya to grace the occasion.Direct Interaction & Guidance: If you set a clear intention and sit with a peaceful, receptive mind, you will be able to connect with these saints and receive direct answers to your deepest life questions.​Transformative Blessings: Obtaining the grace of even a single saint is a profound blessing in itself. The spiritual energy and grace bestowed during the Mahotsav are powerful enough to completely transform your life. Devotees will carry these blessings forever, remaining eternally grateful to Gurudev for providing the rare opportunity to be in such sacred company.What makes attending the Mahotsav a rare and sacred opportunity?​Blessings of the Mantra Guru (Dadi Ji): The Mahotsav offers a sacred and golden opportunity to receive the personal blessings of Parikshit Bhaiya’s Mantra Guru, lovingly addressed by everyone as Dadi Ji (as Parikshit Bhaiya calls her).​An Elevated Soul & Powerhouse: Dadi Ji is a highly revered spiritual soul who has spent decades in intense naam-jaap (mantra chanting). Parikshit Bhaiya often compares himself to a thin live wire, while reverently describing Dadi Ji as the power house or transformer—the original, limitless source from which all the energy and grace flows.​A Rare Occurrence: Dadi Ji visits Ashaeiynn only twice a year—first on Guru Purnima, and second during the annual Mahotsav.​Personal Interaction: On her designated visit day during the Mahotsav, she personally meets, interacts with, and blesses all visiting devotees and guests, making it an extraordinarily rare spiritual experience to be in her presence.Who can attend the Mahotsav, and are there any spiritual or physical preparations required before arriving?Target Audience & Inclusivity​Open to Everyone: The Annual Mahotsav is open to all seekers, regardless of your prior experience or background in spiritual practice. First-time visitors and advanced practitioners alike are equally welcome.​Bringing Guests & Loved Ones: Members of Ashaeiynn are warmly encouraged to bring their family members, children, or friends along—there are no restrictions on who you can invite to share in the experience.​Important Visitor Policy: Non-members are always welcome, but they must be accompanied by an already enrolled Ashaeiynn member. For security and spiritual alignment, Ashaeiynn does not entertain individuals arriving alone if they are not currently enrolled members.​Preparation Requirements​No Pre-Requisites: There are no mandatory spiritual practices, fasting, or physical preparations required before your arrival.​Come as You Are: All that is needed is an open mind, a receptive heart, and a willing spirit. Everything required for your journey and practice will be naturally guided by the mentors and volunteers once you arrive at Ashaeiynn.What special events, cultural programs, and food offerings can guests expect during the Mahotsav?Music, Bhajans & Cultural Programs​Devotional Music & Performances: Experience soulful music, bhajans, and kirtans throughout the celebration, featuring beautiful song performances presented by talented Ashaeiynn members and our beloved Parikshit Bhaiya.​Vibrant Celebration: A wide array of cultural activities and spiritual performances will be organized and enacted throughout the month-long Mahotsav, bringing energy, devotion, and joy to the Ashaeiynn environment.​Humor, Joy & Light-heartedness​Amused by Parikshit Bhaiya’s Humor: You will be thoroughly amused by Parikshit Bhaiya’s natural humor and warm light-heartedness between sessions. His presence brings an immense amount of joy and laughter, keeping the atmosphere uplifting and filled with happiness throughout the event.​Bhandaras & Sacred Food​Community Feasts (Bhandaras): Grand bhandaras will be hosted on various special days across the entire month, serving sanctified prasadam to all visiting devotees, guests, and community members.​Surprises ​Preserving the Element of Surprise: Full details, schedules, and specific highlights will be disclosed directly at the venue upon your arrival—because some experiences are best left as pleasant surprises!​Embracing the Unpredictable: The Mahotsav is driven by divine energy and spontaneous flow. Beyond structured activities, expect many spontaneous events that cannot be predefined. Come prepared to embrace the magic as it unfolds in the moment!Where will guests stay during the Mahotsav, and can we book accommodation outside Ashaeiynn?Staying at Ashaeiynn​Primary Accommodation: Guests are highly encouraged to stay directly within the Ashaeiynn premises to fully immerse themselves in the spiritual atmosphere, daily activities, and community life of the Mahotsav.​Independent Stay & Hotel Options​Freedom to Choose: If you prefer your own personal space or separate arrangements, you are completely free to book accommodation outside Ashaeiynn.​Nearby & City Hotels:​Hotel Green Beach: Conveniently located within short walking distance from Ashaeiynn, making it an ideal choice for quick back-and-forth travel. However, room availability at Hotel Green Beach is quite low, so it is best to avoid relying on it and instead look for options directly in Hisar city or Azad Nagar.​Other City Options: Hisar city offers plenty of reputable choices, such as Lemon Tree and many others. A quick search on Google will bring up a wide array of choices to suit your preferences.​Recommended List: If you would like tailored suggestions, feel free to ask your mentor for a curated list of recommended hotel options nearby.​Long-Term Rental Options​Monthly House Rentals: For those planning an extended stay (such as a month or the entire duration of the Mahotsav), renting a house or apartment in Hisar city or Azad Nagar is a practical and convenient option.​Commuting Note: Since Ashaeiynn is situated on the outskirts of the city, having your own vehicle or personal transportation is recommended if you choose to rent or stay further within the city proper.How do guests reach Ashaeiynn, and what is the best mode of transport?Arriving Directly in Hisar (By Flight or Train)​Local Auto or Cab: If you land at Hisar airport or alight at Hisar railway station, take a direct auto-rickshaw or taxi.​Landmark & Route for Drivers: Local drivers may not know Aashayein by name yet. Ask the driver to take you to Hotel Green Beach, located on the outskirts of Hisar, beyond Gangwa near the bypass.​Specific Directions: Tell the driver that it is on the same road as the Jio Petrol Pump. Go straight past the Jio Petrol Pump for about 2 km, and the hotel will be on the left side near the end of flyover.​Estimated Fare: An auto or cab from Hisar city/station/bus stand to Hotel Green Beach typically costs around ₹200 – ₹250.​Arriving via Delhi (By Flight or Train)​Direct Cab: You can hail or book a direct cab from Delhi (airport, station, or city) straight to Ashaeiynn.​By Bus (Kashmiri Gate):​Head to Kashmiri Gate ISBT in Delhi, where plenty of AC buses operate frequently toward Hisar (private operators like Krishna Travels are widely available).​Take a bus to the Hisar City Bus depot.​From the Hisar bus depot, take an auto-rickshaw directly to Hotel Green Beach beyond Gangwa using the landmark instructions above.​Safety Precautions for Traveling Guests​Live Location & Tracking: For your safety while commuting by auto, cab, or bus, always keep your device location turned on and track your ride/route on GPS as you travel.​Share Trip Status: Share your live location or trip details with family or friends so someone is always aware of your progress.What are the guidelines regarding decorum, guest boundaries, and maintaining the sacred environment of Ashaeiynn?Upholding Sanctity & Respect​Sacred Atmosphere: Ashaeiynn is a sacred space dedicated to spiritual growth, devotion, and peace. All guests and devotees are expected to conduct themselves with high decorum, humility, and reverence for the Ashaeiynn grounds and traditions.​Respecting Boundaries: Mind personal boundaries at all times. Treat fellow visitors, members, and Ashaeiynn staff with mutual respect, courtesy, and consideration.Divine Oversight & Zero-Tolerance Policy​Constant Observation: Beyond physical presence, millions of saints and divine energies reside at the venue during the Mahotsav. Gurudev Himself is keenly observing everyone throughout the event.​Spiritual Consequences: You are not merely under human supervision—Gurudev and the divine presence judge all actions directly. Any misconduct, breach of boundaries, or violation of guidelines will invite direct spiritual action from Gurudev long before any human intervention takes place.​Zero-Tolerance for Misbehaviour: There is a strict zero-tolerance policy for any conduct that disturbs the peace or sanctity of Ashaeiynn. Make every effort to carry yourself with the utmost respect, awareness, and purity of intent.

What is the typical daily schedule during Mahotsav?During the Mahotsav, our schedule is designed to be deeply immersive yet very flexible. While none of the sessions are strictly mandatory, we strongly encourage you to participate in every session. It is a truly rare opportunity to connect face-to-face with Parikshit Bhaiya and your mentors, with whom you normally only interact virtually.Dedicated mantra chanting is the main focus of your stay. Taking time out of a busy life to spend 24 hours a day focused entirely on your sadhana is a priceless gift. To support your practice, a continuous, 24-hour havan will run throughout the event. You are welcome to join in at any time.Daily Highlights:​Mornings: Mentors are available for open discussions before Bhaiya arrives, offering a quiet space to learn and receive profound spiritual knowledge.​Afternoons & Day: Parikshit Bhaiya leads the havan, satsang, and bhajans, while also making personal time to meet visitors individually, check auras, and sharing deep spiritual insights.​Evenings: After Bhaiya takes his leave, mentors step back in to host late-night, hands-on practice sessions focused on third eye development.​Whether you spend your time chanting near the havan, working on your assigned sadhana, engaging with mentors, or offering seva (volunteer service), you are completely free to participate and rest at your own pace.​Are there dedicated times or spaces for silent reflection, rest and personal practice (sadhana)?The entire Ashaeiynn is your home and with our flexible schedule, you are free to pause, rest, or step away whenever you need to. If you are feeling tired or simply want a quiet moment to yourself, you can rest in the Tapa room or ask any volunteer to guide you to a suitable resting area.​You are free to do your individual sadhana anywhere on the grounds or inside the hall. However, since you have taken precious time out of your busy life to be here, we strongly encourage you to do your mantra chanting in the havan area near Parikshit Bhaiya. Since mantra chanting can be done anywhere, sitting in Bhaiya's presence allows you to absorb his energy, insights, and spiritual knowledge while you practice, maximizing every moment of your stay.Will there be opportunities to attend satsang or ask questions directly to the mentors?Yes, absolutely! Parikshit Bhaiya will lead the main satsangs during the day, where he will meet visitors individually, scan auras, and share deep spiritual wisdom.​Additionally, your mentors will be staying directly at Ashaeiynn alongside everyone else to serve and support you. You can reach out to them at any point throughout the day to ask questions, clarify doubts, or seek guidance—including during dedicated morning discussions and late-night practice sessions. We just ask that you remain mindful of their personal space and time so they can rest and recharge while serving the community.Could you advise on the expected dress code for daily activities?Since Ashaeiynn is a sacred space and active spiritual home, we ask all guests to dress in simple, modest, and comfortable clothing that respects the sacred environment. Loose-fitting attire like traditional Indian wear (such as kurta-pyjamas or salwar-kameez) or loose pants and tops are ideal, especially for sitting comfortably during long chanting sessions and havan.​Please ensure shoulders and knees are covered at all times. Women are also requested to bring a scarf (dupatta) to cover their heads during the havan.You are welcome to change into comfortable nightsuit when retiring for the evening. Overall, dressing simply helps keep our collective focus where it belongs: on our sadhana and spiritual growth.What is the Ashaeiynn’s policy regarding the use of phones, laptops, and photography?There are no restrictions on bringing or using phones, laptops, or other electronic devices, and you are free to bring whatever you need. However, to maintain a peaceful, immersive environment for everyone, we kindly ask that devices be used mindfully.Are there any key etiquette guidelines I should keep in mind regarding footwear, seating, or sacred spaces?To keep our sacred space pure and welcoming for everyone, please keep the following guidelines in mind:​Footwear: All footwear must be placed in the designated shoe rack upon entering the main gate. No footwear is permitted inside the sacred grounds or hall.Respecting Sacred Seating (Guru Gaddi): Please do not sit on the sofa inside the main hall or the dedicated sofa outside in the havan area. These are designated as the Guru Gaddi for Parikshit Bhaiya, and we ask everyone to honor and respect these spiritual seats. If you wish to sit on a sofa, comfortable seating is available in the reception area.​Seating & Practice: Please bring your own pooja mat (aasan) to sit on for sadhana. For elderly guests or those with health conditions who are unable to sit on the ground, chairs are placed separately in the area for your comfort.​Hygiene & Cleanliness: Keeping our sacred space squeaky clean and pure is everyone’s shared responsibility—not just the duty of the volunteers and sevaks. Please do not litter. Use the dustbins placed around Ashaeiynn, or ask a volunteer if you cannot find one. Everyone is expected to participate in maintaining high standards of cleanliness and hygiene.​Respecting Property & Utilities: Please treat all Ashaeiynn property with care. Be mindful of our shared resources—turn off lights and fans when leaving a room, use water and soaps consciously, and avoid any wastefulness.​Havan Area: Do not step onto the havan platform—always remain below the platform area.​Follow Signage: Please read and follow all posted instructions and guidelines displayed around Ashaeiynn.​Ask First: If you wish to do something you haven't done before or are unsure about, simply ask a mentor or volunteer first. Above all, maintain respect for the sacredness of the environment and fellow guests.​

How is seva typically assigned, and how many hours of daily service are expected from guests?Seva (selfless service) is a heartfelt expression of devotion, and we welcome everyone to participate according to their own capacity:​Voluntary & Heartfelt: Seva is entirely voluntary—there is no obligation or set expectation. Every disciple and guest is free to serve according to their own faith, time, and devotion toward Gurudev.​Cultivating Humility: While not mandatory, participating in seva is warmly encouraged. As disciples of Gurudev, offering service in any small way is a meaningful duty that helps cultivate deep humility, inner purity, and connection with the community.​No Fixed Hours or Standards: There are no set limitations or rigid hours required. Whether you can offer a few minutes or a couple of hours, every act of service is appreciated. To each their own—you are free to contribute in whatever way feels right for you.Is it possible to offer specific skills—such as gardening, maintenance, or cooking—toward my seva?Every contribution, big or small, plays a vital role in supporting our community:​All Skills Welcome: Whatever your unique talents or abilities—whether technical, creative, organizational, or practical—they are warmly welcomed.​Service Over Skill: More than any specific talent, it is your spirit of service (bhava) and willingness to contribute that truly matters.​Serve in Your Own Way: If you feel drawn to serve in a specific area or offer a particular skill, you are fully encouraged to do so. Simply inform a volunteer or mentor, and we will help align your service with what you enjoy doing most.Who should I check in with regarding my daily duties and assignments?To get started with your seva or if you have any questions during your stay:​Coordinate with Volunteers & Mentors: You can check in directly with our event volunteers or your assigned mentors upon arrival or at any point during the Mahotsav.​Task Guidance: They will guide you on current needs, help assign specific tasks that fit your preference or skill set, and ensure you have everything required for a seamless and fulfilling service experience.How does the community handle regular check-ins or group updates among guests and residents?To ensure everyone stays informed and up to date throughout the Mahotsav:​Live Announcements: Important information, schedule updates, and general announcements will be broadcast regularly using microphones and speakers across the venue.​Dedicated Host: Parikshit Bhaiya will be guiding the event live, sharing key announcements and updates as they happen.​Ashaeiynn App Access: All live updates, schedules, and notices will also be made available directly within the official app for your convenience.Could you explain how shared living areas are maintained and what guests are responsible for keeping clean?We want to ensure everyone has a comfortable, organized, and peaceful stay. Please keep the following guidelines in mind regarding accommodation and facility care:​Shared Accommodation: There are no separate private rooms or quarters. Everyone will sleep together in the main halls or in specific arrangements organized by the Ashaeiynn team. Rest assured, there is plenty of space to comfortably accommodate everyone!​Sleeping on the Ground: In our tradition, only the Guru sits on a throne (Guru Gaddi), while all devotees sleep on the ground to foster humility and devotion. Bed frames are not provided; mattresses, bedsheets, pillows, and light blankets will be supplied. You are also welcome to bring your own bedding.​Daily Routine & Daytime Rules:​No Daytime Bedding Setup: Bedding cannot be set up or left out during the day. You may only spread out your bedding at night when you are ready to sleep.​Resting Areas: If you need to rest during the day, you may lie down in the designated resting/top room, but sleeping essentials cannot be unpacked there.​Morning Tidy-Up: Upon waking, everyone is required to pack up their own bedding and return mattresses, pillows, and sheets to their proper places. Please do not leave them for others or volunteers to clean up.​Shared Responsibility for Cleanliness: Keeping ashaeiynn clean is a collective responsibility, not just the job of volunteers. Since all living areas are shared, everyone’s cooperation in maintaining hygiene and order is warmly encouraged and appreciated.​Luggage Room & Personal Belongings:​A dedicated luggage room is available to store your bags. To accommodate hundreds of guests smoothly, please keep the area tidy, organize your items, and avoid leaving clothes on top of bags or cluttering the space.​Keep Belongings Secured: You are responsible for setting up your own sleeping area and managing your own items. Please keep all personal belongings zipped inside your luggage bags. While the entire Ashaeiynn is under CCTV surveillance, the management is not responsible for missing items.​Hall & Restroom Facilities: The main halls are fully air-conditioned and spacious. There are two separate sets of dedicated bathrooms for men and women.​Laundry & Rain Care: A washing machine is available, and clothes can be dried on the roof. As it will be the rainy season, please bring extra poly bags to store wet clothes.​Queries & Support: Volunteers are on hand to assist and manage spaces, but if you have any questions or need help finding bedding provisions, please feel free to ask them.When are meals served, and how do duties like meal preparation or cleanup work?To ensure everyone is well-fed, hydrated, and comfortable while maintaining cleanliness and harmony throughout the Mahotsav:Drinking Water Availability: Water coolers providing both normal and cold drinking water are available on-site, so you do not need to purchase water bottles from outside.​Tea & Coffee Availability: A tea and coffee vending machine is conveniently located in the reception/dining area. You do not need to worry about getting your early morning or evening cup—it is readily accessible right there.​Strict Pure Vegetarian Policy: Only 100% pure vegetarian food is permitted on the Ashaeiynn premises. Meat and non-vegetarian items are strictly prohibited inside. Any non-vegetarian meals must be consumed entirely outside Ashaeiynn grounds.​Sponsored & Community Meals: During Mahotsav, generous devotees often sponsor bulk meals out of service (Seva). So, you need not worry about food during the event. However, as these meals are usually ordered in bulk from restaurants, they may not suit everyone with strict dietary requirements. If you would like to sponsor a meal, please speak with your assigned mentor to select a specific day and coordinate your contribution. ​Tiffin Services & Delivery: If you prefer home-cooked style food or have specific dietary restrictions, local tiffin services are a great option (volunteers can guide you). Food delivery apps like Zomato and Swiggy are also available.
While your schedule during the event will be busy, the kitchen at Ashaeiynn is open if you’d like to whip up a simple snack or late-night bite.
To help us keep the space safe, clean, and enjoyable for everyone, please keep the following in mind:
Fully Equipped: The kitchen is stocked with all the plates and utensils you’ll need—no need to bring your own.
Kitchen Rules: Please follow the posted guidelines (Do’s and Don’ts) inside the kitchen regarding safety and proper equipment use.
Clean As You Go: Kindly wash your plates and utensils immediately after eating and return them to their designated spots.

​Nearby Dining Options:​Hotel Green Beach: Located right next to ashaeiynn within walking distance—ideal if you need an early breakfast or prefer dining outside.​Nearby Restaurants: If you have a vehicle, options like Haveli are located just a few kilometers away.​Personal Snacks & Pest Control: You are welcome to bring personal vegetarian snacks. However, to prevent rodents and pests, all edible items must be stored securely inside hard, impenetrable containers inside your luggage.

Designated Dining Area: All meals, snacks, beverages, and prasad must be consumed exclusively in the designated dining/reception area—never in sleeping halls, luggage rooms, or sacred ritual spaces. Please always clean up your eating space after use.What essentials should I pack, and how are daily needs, medical requirements, and luggage managed at Ashaeiynn?Identity Verification & Check-In​Mandatory Official ID: All attending members must bring a valid government-issued photo ID (such as an Aadhaar card, PAN card, Voter ID, Driver's License, or Passport) to ensure a smooth and seamless check-in process upon arrival.Luggage Storage & Daily Needs​Luggage Room Provided: A designated luggage room is provided for storing all your bags, luggage, and personal items throughout your stay to keep the living spaces neat and uncluttered.​Assistance On-Site: All your basic day-to-day needs will be met during the Mahotsav. If you require something that is not immediately available, simply ask the volunteers—they will be happy to assist and arrange it for you.​Medical Conditions & Personal Medication​Bring Your Own Medicines: Guests with pre-existing medical conditions must bring an adequate supply of their own prescribed medications and medical provisions.​No Nearby Pharmacies: Pharmacies are not available in the immediate vicinity of Ashaeiynn.​On-Site Doctor: While we have a doctor available at Ashaeiynn for general assistance, it is essential and highly beneficial that you carry your own necessary medications and personal care supplies for the duration of your stay.​Packing Checklist & Essential Items​Weather & Rain Gear: Since it is the rainy season, please make sure to bring umbrellas and raincoats.​Weather-Appropriate Clothing: The weather in Ashaeiynn can be hot and humid, causing extra sweating. Please pack enough light clothing as well as extra pairs of innerwear to stay comfortable.​Personal Hygiene & Grooming:​Bring your own deodorants and perfumes to help you stay fresh throughout the day in the humidity.​Pack your personal toiletries (soap, shampoo, sanitary products, etc.), hair dryer, washing powder/detergent, and enough towels.​Attire Guidelines:​Traditional Wear: Traditional attire is highly appreciated for pujas and special spiritual events.​Attire for Women: Women are requested to bring scarves or dupattas.​Personal Bedding Preference: While shared accommodations are provided, you are welcome to bring your own bedsheets and pillows if you prefer not to use common shared bedding.​Sacred Area Rules: Leather & Animal Products​Strict Havan Area Restrictions: Items made of leather or animal skin (such as leather belts, bags, purses, or shoes) are strictly prohibited in and around the havan area.​Please ensure all leather items are removed and safely stored inside your luggage before entering the havan space.​Important Notice for Women Guests Regarding Menstrual Planning​Sacred Space Restrictions: In accordance with Ashaeiynn's traditional discipline, women currently on their periods are not permitted to enter the main halls or the havan area, nor participate in the rituals inside. Access is restricted to the reception area.​Plan Your Visit Accordingly: We strongly recommend scheduling your travel after your periods are over so you can fully participate in the Mahotsav. If you must travel during your period, please be aware in advance of these space restrictions.​Off-Site Accommodation Suggestion: Because the reception area will be extremely crowded during the event, resting there for extended periods may become uncomfortable. We highly advise booking a nearby hotel outside the Ashaeiynn if you are attending during your cycle so you can rest comfortably.When does the Mahotsav begin, is there any limit to how long I can stay, and how much time should I plan for my visit?​Mahotsav Dates: The 25-day Mahotsav officially begins on 12th September 2026.​Arriving Early: Depending on personal convenience and travel schedules, visitors are welcome to arrive early. Some guests choose to come 2 days early, while others arrive up to a week in advance. You are free to plan your arrival according to what works best for you.​Recommended Duration & Flexibility​Minimum Recommended Stay (2–3 Days): We strongly encourage all visitors to plan for at least a 2 to 3-day stay. Due to the large number of devotees attending, the queues and lineups can be long. Staying for a minimum of 2 to 3 days ensures that Gurudev and Parikshit Bhaiya can dedicate quality time to you and that you have a genuine opportunity to speak with Parikshit Bhaiya personally.​Ideal Experience (Full 25 Days): While you are free to stay for as long as your schedule permits, it is ideal to stay for the entire 25-day duration to perform your sadhana and fully immerse yourself in the spiritual environment.​Extending Stay Beyond the Festival: ​If you wish to extend your stay and remain at Ashaeiynn beyond the official conclusion of the Mahotsav, you must inform your assigned mentor.What happens when I first arrive at Ashaeiynn, and how will volunteers and mentors help me settle in?Arrival & Shoe Etiquette​Footwear Policy: No footwear is permitted inside the premises. As soon as you enter through the main gate of Ashaeiynn, you will find a shoe rack located on your right-hand side. Please remove your shoes and place them safely in the rack before proceeding.​Reception & Check-In Process​Warm Welcome: After placing your shoes in the rack, walk through the large main glass entrance door. On your left, you will find the reception desk, where the Ashaeiynn team will welcome you.​ID Verification & Passes: Official staff and volunteers will guide you through the check-in process:​Registered Members: Will be issued an official Member Pass/ID.​Accompanying Guests & Non-Members: Will be issued a Visitor Pass/ID.​Note: Please have your official government-issued ID ready for verification.​Identifying Volunteers & Mentors​Easy Spotting: You will be living alongside dedicated volunteers and mentors throughout your stay, so guidance is always nearby.​Volunteers: Can be easily identified by the specific color of their ID lanyards/wristbands, which differ from guest badges.​Mentors: Can be identified by their special badges or sashes.​Orientation & Settling In Step-by-StepYou don't need to worry about navigating Ashaeiynn on your own—our volunteers will walk you through everything step by step:​Luggage Storage: Volunteers will assist you in taking your bags and belongings to the designated luggage room.​Freshening Up: They will guide you to the restrooms so you can unpack basic needs and freshen up after your journey.​Ashaeiynn Tour: They will give you an introductory tour of the ashaeiynn grounds and key areas.Initial Spiritual Arrival Process: Volunteers will walk you through the essential initial spiritual rituals required upon arriving on the grounds:​Veneration of Rameshwar Sarkar: Offering jal (water) and performing puja dedicated to Rameshwar Sarkar.​Main Hall Darshan: Entering the main hall to bow down and offer your prayers before the two Akhand Deepaks and Gurudev’s idol.​Havan Area & Parikrama: Proceeding to the havan area to perform the sacred Parikrama.​Meeting Parikshit Bhaiya: Following these arrival rituals, volunteers will guide you directly to meet Parikshit Bhaiya based on availability.
